checked_classes: Spec violations — prerequisite completion, documentation and deployment surfaces, targeted gates, evidence, release impact, and unresolved deployment and registry limits were checked without finding a concrete violation.

Correctness — workflow gating, base-path routing, search state flow, generated API and evidence pipelines, native artifact parity, containment helpers, and local request handling were checked without finding a concrete defect.
Regressions — runtime changes are documentation-comment-only, README parity is generated from authoritative inventories, and protected npm tags and publication behavior remain unchanged.

Security — Pages permissions are least-privilege, actions are commit-pinned, npm staging is stage-only OIDC, evidence is hash and receipt bound, and filesystem and request boundaries reject traversal and symlink escape.
Constraint breaches — the diff preserves pnpm-only operation and the component-to-hook-to-store-to-service search layering.

Silent failure — search loading failures surface an unavailable state, HTTP resolution failures return explicit errors, generators and verifiers fail closed, and public deployment and npm registration limits remain recorded.
